text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since Valentine's Day is coming up, Eishin Flash and I visit a chocolate shop to see what's popular this year.

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! I was in line first! Hey, quit shoving!

text_block_list.name: Employees
text_block_list.text: Would all customers interested in purchasing chocolates please line up here—in an orderly manner, please!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What chaos…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It doesn't look like we'll be able to browse at our leisure. What a shame…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I've already purchased what I wanted online, so let's go back.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I have witnessed that same scene many times since my arrival in Japan, but I still find it curious.
choice_data_list: Why so? Are things different in Germany?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We celebrate Valentine's Day as well, but flowers are the primary gift of choice.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Also, only partners give and receive gifts… The custom of giving "obligatory chocolates" does not exist.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My father would gift roses to my mother every year without fail.
choice_data_list: So the idea of giving a gift to someone special is the same.
So the idea of giving a gift to someone special is the same.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's a little different, I think. In Germany, the gift is not given as a love confession.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, why do people confess their love to another on Valentine's Day in the first place?
choice_data_list: Maybe because the day itself makes it easier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain how it's easier to prepare yourself when you've chosen a date to confess, especially on Valentine's Day—the day of love.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so it essentially creates a pretext… I think I have a general grasp on the idea now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, a confession of love would irreversibly change the established status quo between two people.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: As such, it would be more considerate to express your appreciation to someone regularly instead of making a spontaneous show of affection.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …I do not have any examples as of now. May I please have a little time to think upon it?
choice_data_list: Oh, you don't have to think about it that hard…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No, but I wish to think it through myself. …At any rate, let's return home for now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Valentine's Day arrives.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Please accept this. It's a chocolate cake.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Why was that phrased as a question? This is a perfectly standard Valentine's Day gift.
choice_data_list: But you said giving obligatory gifts isn't customary for you…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I have put a great deal of thought into the matter since then and realized gift giving is an easy method to express one's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ergo, I decided to partake in the custom. However, this is meant to convey my gratitude for you and not a confession by any means.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I've come to realize why people give each other chocolate on Valentine's Day, however.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Because they want to see how surprised their recipient will be as well as how troubled they become over the gift's intention.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I jest, of course. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer. My homeroom teacher wishes to speak with you. Are you available right now?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Then I shall wait here and review my training schedule while you two speak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her homeroom teacher makes small talk with me about how wonderful a student Flash is.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Good. All looks well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah, welcome back.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I will be going now. I'll see you again tomorrow at nine o'clock to discuss my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Um…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Do you recall the discussion we had previously about expressing your appreciation to someone on a regular basis?
choice_data_list: Oh, the one we had on Valentine's Day?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In the end, I think it might be best to show your feelings to them directly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, simply being kind will not suffice. You must impart them with something.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: For example, let's say you give a flower to someone who doesn't normally keep them in their house.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That flower will become part of their daily life but, inevitably, will wilt and be thrown out at some point.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: At that point, the person will become aware of a new potential lifestyle—one with flowers.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: And maybe, just maybe… they will think of the person who gave them that flower, too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …That is all. Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After Eishin Flash leaves, I notice a sweet floral scent in the air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Its deep crimson petals look as smooth as velvet as it sways in the breeze.
